verdict.rationale: Jules ships explicit background-automation primitives: it clones repos into a VM, plans and executes tasks asynchronously, notifies on completion, and offers an API with automationMode/session fields to trigger workflows from GitHub issues, Slack, or Linear without a human driving each step. Community reports confirm real background PR generation (e.g., a non-technical customer merging Jules-authored PRs unattended), though other users note it often needs babysitting or gets stuck in loops, showing autonomy is imperfect in practice. Missing for 10: no evidence of native scheduling/cron-like triggers, and no independent benchmark of unattended success rate over long-running tasks.
